verdict.rationale: Maritime's evidence describes deploying persistent Docker-based agents (any Docker image with sleep/wake/channels/triggers), a Files API, and a Linux desktop 'Computers' feature, but nothing describes a code-execution/sandbox API that runs snippets in multiple language runtimes (Python, JS, etc.) and returns structured/rich results (e.g., stdout, images, dataframes) the way a code-interpreter tool would.
